information: Ver la pestaña [Registro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ItsClockingTimeLima2024#36486-registro-registration) para obtener información detallada. Además, todos los competidores deben conocer [el reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) Debido a cuestiones de aforo, los participantes deben evitar asistir con invitados. See the [Registration](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ItsClockingTimeLima2024#36486-registro-registration) tab for detailed information. Also, all competitors should be aware of [the WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) Due to capacity limitations, participants should avoid attending with guests.
